conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniels with the Refund Verification Department. Can I have your full name, please?
Uh, yes, it's Anna Perez.
Thank you, Ms. Perez. I'm contacting you in regards to your pending federal tax refund for this year. Our records show that your payout is on hold due to an unresolved identity verification fee.
I... I didn't know I had a refund coming. And what's an identity verification fee?

The IRS has implemented strict anti-fraud protocols. Before we can release your refund, we must confirm your identity via a refundable processing fee of $349. This is standard under IRS Code Section 301.7216.
I've never heard of that before. Can't you just take it out of the refund?

Unfortunately, for legal compliance reasons, verification fees must be settled prior to disbursing any tax refunds. If the fee is not paid within the next two hours, your refund will be permanently forfeited and your case may be flagged for further review.
That sounds serious... Am I in trouble with the IRS or something?
If the fee is not paid, your file may be escalated, resulting in penalties or an audit. I strongly advise you to resolve this immediately to avoid any legal complications.
Okay, what do I need to do to pay it?

For your security, the IRS only accepts this fee via approved digital payment methods. You can complete the process using Apple gift cards, Google Play gift cards, or by sending funds to the provided IRS crypto-wallet address.
Gift cards? That doesn't sound like an IRS thing.

Ma'am, these are secure, traceable payment options instituted for identity verification purposes. Please do not question established IRS procedures. Failure to comply may result in immediate suspension of your taxpayer status.
Alright, so where do I get these gift cards?
You may purchase Apple or Google Play gift cards at any major retail store or pharmacy. You will need to obtain cards totaling $349 and then provide me with the numbers from the back of the cards.
And once I do that, I get my refund?

Correct. Once your fee is processed, your refund will be released within 24 hours. Please confirm when you are ready to provide the gift card codes, or I can supply you the IRS crypto-wallet if you prefer.
I guess the gift cards are easier... Should I go to the store now?
Yes, please proceed immediately. Call me back as soon as you have the cards to avoid any interruption in your refund process. Remember, you have less than two hours before your refund is revoked.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Can you wait on the line?
I will remain on the line to guide you through the process. Please notify me as soon as you have acquired the cards.
Alright, I'm heading out now.
Thank you for your cooperation, Ms. Perez. Please remember: any delay may result in legal action or loss of your refund. I will wait for your confirmation.
